title: Taxation Bill 2026 Extends Electronics Capital Goods Tax Exemption Sunset to March 31, 2041
summary: Provides 15-year long-term tax predictability for semiconductor and electronics manufacturing hardware.

blocks.content: Provides 15-year long-term tax predictability for semiconductor and electronics manufacturing hardware.

items: Taxation Bill 2026 extends the sunset clause for customs duty exemption on imported capital goods used in electronics manufacturing to **March 31, 2041**.
Supports India's target to build a $500 billion electronics manufacturing ecosystem.

blocks.title: Static Background & GK Context
blocks.summary: Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs (CBIC) Chairman: Sanjay Kumar Agarwal.
